notes.title: SCP-9735-Alpha – Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I’d like to share a quick update on the current state of SCP-9735-Alpha.

First and foremost: The project is not abandoned! I’m still actively working on it. Since this is a one-man project, progress takes a bit more time – especially because I’ve set the bar quite high for myself while also working with a limited budget.

Right now, I’m focusing on a rework of the story as well as the overall game concept. In parallel, I’m also collaborating with an SCP author to officially integrate SCP-9735-Alpha into the SCP Universe.

I know there haven’t been many updates recently, so I’d like to sincerely thank everyone who continues to wait patiently and support this project. 🙏
Going forward, my goal is to provide more regular updates to keep you all in the loop.

Thank you for your interest and support – you are what keeps me motivated to continue!



~ PeazBlack
